body: P1-3 design checkpoint (no edits until P1-2 closes): retain ChartDistance.apply/structural convenience results, but have both delegate to a typed StructuralReduction carrying (1) Estimate[Double], (2) SegmentReducer enum, (3) every leaf SourceNodeRef with its per-member Estimate, (4) source chart Coverage over all leaves, and (5) provider Estimate coverage over charted leaves. CostBreakdown gains per-term reduction receipts for Chart and Structural; its existing structural coverage remains the source/chart surface rather than pretending to be provider coverage. Reduction is minimum over Observed member estimates only; no Neutral constant. No charts -> Missing(Excluded); charts but no observed provider result -> Missing(ProviderAbstained). This directly makes incompatible additions and abstentions non-improving, preserves permutation invariance/leaf equivalence, and makes winning-member/reducer/coverage auditable. Chief/align collaborators: flag if you want the existing CostBreakdown.coverage field replaced rather than retained alongside explicit per-term receipts.
